svg.text: What a seed makes: a sphere of biomes, 12 cities and about 30 towns, each with a place, a size and a seed. Drawn from the prototype generator (seed 7).
Shaded discs are the reach of each settlement.
Planet radius 24446 units: a great circle is 153,600 units, the length of today's arena.
8 bytes. The planet is a pure function of it.
12 cities + about 31 towns + their landmarks: a place, a
size, a kind and a seed each. About 48 bytes a record:
6 faces x 128 x 128 cells of 300 units, 4 bytes each:
384 KB. For a map screen and a fast read; it can be
thrown away and rebuilt from the seed.
Craters and levelled buildings as a short list per place
(a few KB), so a flattened city stays flat next fight.
The ground itself. At the sim's 32-unit columns the whole sphere would be
7.3 million cells, about 14.6 MB at two bytes. The slice reads only its own
4,800 columns (19 KB) from the seed when a fight starts.
